cohort: 165 women with 144 twin and 21 triplet pregnancies
finding: Neonates from triplet pregnancies were born preterm, had lower birth weight, and required neonatal intensive care unit admission more often compared to those from twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with triplets compared to those with twins.
gest_age: Twin pregnancies: 36.0 ± 3.05 weeks, Triplet pregnancies: 32 ± 3.81 weeks
birth_weight: Twin pregnancies: 2333.83 ± 558.69 grams, Triplet pregnancies: 1553.41 ± 569.73 grams
